target_semantics_lesson: The target is the monthly growth rate of US housing starts for September 2024, categorized into three buckets: below -4.883%, between -4.883% and 7.204%, or at or above 7.204%.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate checkpoints with current, cutoff-safe data. Official reports or dated independent reporting are required to confirm factors like mortgage rate forecasts or interest rate cut discussions.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Connect current evidence to drivers (e.g., mortgage rates, rate cuts) and mediators (e.g., housing demand, builder caution) to forecast housing starts. The mechanism requires activating historical factors and demonstrating a prospective bridge.
counterevidence_lesson: Historical builder caution can restrain starts, even with supportive rates. Assess if this negative sentiment persists and contradicts other positive indicators for September 2024.
calibration_lesson: Confidence decreases if the weakest link (e.g., indirect evidence, historical factor without current confirmation) is removed. Test competing paths and evaluate if counterevidence dominates the proposed causal chain.
